parameters_inherited.signal: Third-plus AND saved daily-50%-rally veto AND dilution >=25% for primary comparison; other arms preserved

parent_policy.entry_session: Original eligible entry session; no new future-public information
parent_policy.arrival: 09:31 ET for continuous-session primary; source availability and valid-market gates must also pass
parent_policy.participation_denominator: Deduplicated external observed volume through latest available timestamp; independent reserve for working and pending-cancel children
admission_requires: broker-confirmed usable borrow quantity and expiry
valid as-of NBBO and market status
allowed route and dated price grid
remaining net-edge estimate positive after covering and costs
parent_policy.freshness_definition: Age of the validated market state and feed continuity/heartbeat, not time since the last quote price change.
parent_policy.reprice_exception: Discretionary cooldown never delays route-required handling or a safety cancellation.
parent_policy.cap_basis: Fixed parent share budget from $100,000 / valid arrival midpoint; track actual fill proceeds separately and never expand the share budget after a price decline.
parent_policy.deadline_reference: 09:31 ET plus the declared window on the original entry session; no restart or extension after a halt, borrow delay or rejected child.

policies.name: Matched SSR-skip control
policies.role: Same clear-status execution, clocks and other rules; skip only restricted states

policies.name: Improve to route-permitted price above NBB
Broker/venue-native SSR repricer
policies.requires: Verified behavior and supported access for actual security/account

comparison_definition: 3 continuous-session methods x 2 windows x 2 participation rates; original skip control separate
optional_followups: Venue-supported opening auction as separate experiment
Broker-supported passive peg or midpoint route after verification
Delayed next eligible session as separately defined strategy
fill_models: Conservative event-level queue, with no unobserved cancellation credit
Alternative measured queue assumptions calibrated only from prior own executions
live_parity: One deterministic decision state machine; historical exchange simulator versus isolated broker adapter
simulation_requirements: Receipt-time or latency-aware market events; no final-day volume at order decision
Do not fill solely because a bar touched the limit
No duplicate consolidated/direct-feed volume or reuse of unchanged depth
Route-specific initially-displayed-order handling; no unconditional repricing on bid touch
Partial fills, pending-cancel fills, borrow reservations, per-child fees and cover liabilities
Keep original signal-anchored exit clock in primary; recent incomplete positions remain marked
No blanket 50% restricted fill assumption in credible primary replay

proof_checkpoints.shadow: All eligible decisions logged, with quote/status/borrow coverage and no unsupported fill claims
proof_checkpoints.execution_pilot: At least 200 child attempts over 30 SSR parent decisions and 20 issuers, plus adequate fills in each chosen quote/spread regime; minimum checkpoint, not automatic validation
proof_checkpoints.strategy_evidence: At least 50 eligible future parent decisions over 30 issuers; uncertainty and adverse-selection/concentration/cost/exit checks still required
proof_checkpoints.scale: Small authorized parents first; increase only after realized borrow, fill, shortfall and cover calibration. $100k remains the ceiling.

operational_boundary.SSI: Research, intent display and Flex HTTPS reconciliation; no standing/polling Gateway connection
operational_boundary.autonomous_executor: Separately reviewed service and broker connection isolated from SPX Gateway; no client ID assigned here
operational_boundary.authorization: A future live implementation requires broker access and explicit order authorization; no trades or settings changed by this proposal

control_definition: A matched E0 for each window/participation setting isolates SSR execution. Preserve the old opening-fill backtest as a separate diagnostic, not as the matched execution control.
historical_borrow: Keep conditional-on-borrow replay separate from borrow-verified replay. Current indicative inventory cannot establish past locates.
